label: report-only telemetry off the PR critical path (ci.yml tail becomes test-aggregate)
description: same-SHA topology checkpoint for the W3 relocation: the report-only shard-plan-report job moves out of ci.yml (where, as the workflow-tail job with needs: [test-aggregate] and if: always(), its full ~286s duration extended every PR run) into a post-workflow telemetry workflow triggered by workflow_run: CI completed + workflow_dispatch. Job name, artifact contract (shard-plan-report / shard-plan-report.log / retention 7d / if-no-files-found: ignore), report content (duration-aware plan + FAST_SHARD_COUNT N=4/6/8 study) and same-SHA provenance are unchanged; only placement changes. Required checks are unchanged. This is a topology checkpoint, not a cohort.

telemetry_relocation_contract.ci_yml_seam: grep -c '^  shard-plan-report:' .github/workflows/ci.yml == 0 (no ci.yml job of that name; only the relocation pointer comment remains)
telemetry_relocation_contract.same_sha_checkout: actions/checkout ref = triggering run's head SHA (workflow_run.head_sha, or latest completed CI run for workflow_dispatch)
telemetry_relocation_contract.artifact_download: gh run download <triggering run id> --pattern 'test-results-fast-*' with continue-on-error: true (tolerant, matching the former in-CI download step)
telemetry_relocation_contract.loud_failure: plan-build/summary/upload steps carry no continue-on-error; a planner failure fails the telemetry workflow (failed run + retained log) and can never fail or block the pull-request workflow
